title: It's weird that most of “Hacker” news is dominated by business news
guide_zh: 发帖者觉得 HN 商业新闻过多，希望看到更多围绕软件和技术本身的讨论。
author: greendude29
excerpt: I know that "tech" is all about startups and business success, but I'd like to see conversations about software, hardware, computer science, and hacker culture resurge and dominate here. Of course HN is run by YC so there will always be the mod posts about startups and jobs, but it seems the community here sometimes tilts more towards business than technology. Just a personal thought, would like to hear if others also have a similar perception.

title: VSCode deprecates Enable Telemetry, auto-enrolls you in Telemetry?
guide_zh: 发帖者质疑 VS Code 遥测设置变更是否会把此前退出的用户重新纳入。
author: tmpfile
excerpt: VSCode has deprecated "Enable Telemetry" and now auto-enrolls you into their new Telemetry option even if you've disabled all the previous telemetry settings. Screenshot https://imgur.com/a/nxvH8cW The changes apply to the most recent version of vscode (version 1.61.0 released Oct 7).
